name: Tsenta
description: Job application agent with a hosted MCP server: assistants find roles, tailor resumes, submit applications and track them from your Tsenta account. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Find Job Roles
skills.description: Find open roles that fit the user's Tsenta profile and check which application systems they use.

skills.name: Submit Job Applications
skills.description: Submit an application to a real employer with a chosen resume, using the account's application allowance.

skills.name: Track Applications
skills.description: Review application status, the tracker and the inbox for the user's submitted applications.

skills.name: Find Hiring Contacts
skills.description: Find the best contact at a company, return a verified work email, and save an outreach draft.
